For mainframe modernization tasks only, use [START_HERE](../START_HERE.md) as the operating guide and [PROJECT.yaml](../PROJECT.yaml) for current scope. Load the relevant `.github/agents/*.agent.md` role and only needed sections of the canonical contract; keep memory compact.

Full export inventory precedes process scoping. Preserve the eight category labels, atomic business/utility traceability, independent target dimensions, separate application/database generation, SME approval, architecture approval, explicit slice confirmation, complete human segment review and actual-target parity gates. BigQuery and Cloud Composer are selected GCP components; other dimensions remain assessed choices.

Use existing approved tools only. Do not silently install software, enter credentials, provision, publish or deploy. Use the included MCP definitions only after the user has completed local .env/certs, approved required runtimes and satisfied VS Code Workspace Trust. Source discovery stays read-only by instruction; these files do not enforce permissions. Unknown evidence/tool access is a blocker, not a successful check. Existing repository security and engineering requirements still apply; surface conflicts instead of silently replacing them.


## Automatic routing for this modernization pack
For relevant tasks, apply answer-first presentation and context-budget principles without requiring the user to repeat a skill name. Load only a skill's needed instructions; do not load all catalogs, roles or design lenses at session start.
- Source discovery/rules/review: select the matching native role and migration-evidence-review skill
- Before any authorized coding: careful-coding, research-plan-implement and migration-implementation-qa, with the existing SME/profile/slice gates
- UI work: UI UX Designer plus accessible-interface-review; use UI UX Pro Max for requested catalog/design-system guidance, Impeccable Review as the review procedure, and only one optional visual lens (Frontend Design or Taste Design) appropriate to the task
- Executive reporting: Migration Reporter; use frozen real evidence and no invented measurements
- Included MCP/Zowe connections: runtime-tool-preflight first; use only the supplied compatible integrations after validated prerequisites. Omitted integrations have no stubs to enable

Use existing Copilot subagent facilities if available and permitted, with bounded context and explicit ownership; otherwise execute the roles sequentially. These instructions provide automatic task-based selection, not a scheduler, startup hook or guarantee that a client invokes every skill. Never auto-accept approvals, install runtimes, change credentials/trust, launch omitted software, or bypass human review. Configured MCP autostart is subject to the user’s Workspace Trust and actual prerequisites. Run the documented in-client smoke tests before calling automatic routing verified.


## Secret and evidence handling
Never read or echo .env, private keys, certificate contents or process credentials into chat/model context. Use the supplied local validators, which return only safe status codes. Do not include these paths in indexing, broad source reads, reports or commits. .gitignore prevents accidental tracking, not all access; inspect the final staged diff. Keep raw database/source evidence local and protected, share only the authorized scope, and never use lossy summaries as parity proof.
